title: Boids of a Feather Flock Together - Evolving Prey Behaviours Under Different Predator Attack Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2609.37885v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flocking and schooling are thought to have evolved partly as defences against predation, but how prey should balance social and escape tendencies may depend on the predator's hunting strategy. We extend the predator-prey boids model of Ojo et al. (2023), itself based on Reynolds' boids, by combining six prey movement tendencies (alignment, cohesion, separation, dodge, repel and wiggle) into a single weighted acceleration update, and by reformulating wiggle as a sinusoidal manoeuvre. We then use an evolutionary strategy to optimise the six behaviour coefficients for collective prey survival against four predator hunting strategies: attack-centroid, attack-nearest, attack-random and attack-peripheral. Across five independent trials per strategy, coefficients converged within trials and mean fitness remained stable or increased, although trials often settled in different local optima. translated_title: 物以类聚，Boids以群分——不同捕食者攻击策略下猎物行为的演化
translated_abstract: 集群与结群行为被认为部分上是作为抵御捕食的防御手段而演化出来的，但猎物应如何在社交倾向与逃跑倾向之间取得平衡，可能取决于捕食者的捕猎策略。我们扩展了Ojo等人（2023）的捕食者-猎物boids模型（该模型本身基于Reynolds的boids模型），将六种猎物运动倾向（对齐、聚集、分离、闪避、排斥和摆动）组合成单一的加权加速度更新，并将摆动重新表述为正弦机动。随后，我们使用进化策略来优化这六种行为系数，以在四种捕食者捕猎策略（攻击质心、攻击最近者、攻击随机个体、攻击外围）下最大化猎物种群的生存。在每种策略下进行五次独立试验，各系数在试验内收敛，平均适应度保持稳定或有所提升，尽管不同试验往往收敛于不同的局部最优。猎物在攻击质心策略下的生存率最高，而在……
tldr: 本研究扩展了捕食者-猎物boids模型，将六种猎物行为倾向合并为加权加速度并改用正弦摆动，用进化策略针对四种捕食者攻击策略优化行为系数，发现不同策略下猎物收敛于不同局部最优，且在“攻击质心”策略下生存率最高。
